name: jev
title: Jev
description: Type what you want in plain English and Jev figures out what to do — open a recent download, launch an app, find a file, or open a site.
author: naz3eh

commands.name: ask-jev
commands.title: Ask Jev
commands.subtitle: Type it, press ↵
commands.description: Turn a plain-English request into a concrete action: open a recent download, launch an app, find a file, or open a site.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: TypeSafe API Key
preferences.description: Your TypeSafe API key from https://docs.typesafe.ai — kept on-device, sent only to api.typesafe.ai.

preferences.name: shareInstalledApps
preferences.label: Share installed app names with Jev
preferences.description: Sends your installed app names to api.typesafe.ai so requests like "open cursor" match the right app. Turn off to keep every local name on-device — file names are already sent only when a request is about opening a file.
